title: Biochemical investigations using mass spectrometry to monitor JMJD6-catalysed hydroxylation of multi-lysine containing bromodomain-derived substrates
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00311J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thomas P. Corner, Eidarus Salah, Anthony Tumber, Lennart Brewitz, Christopher J. Schofield
High-throughput mass spectrometric assays monitoring JMJD6-catalysed hydroxylation of multi-lysine containing BRD2–4 derived oligopeptides are reported. Kinetic studies reveal the dependence of JMJD6 catalysis on O2 availability.
